faq.answer:
We are actively hiring talented engineers! 🚀

Click **'🎯 Open Jobs & Careers'** or the **'💼 Careers'** button above to browse all current openings and submit your application with your resume/LinkedIn link in 30 seconds.

You can schedule a 1-on-1 online video consultation with our Solutions Architect!

Click **'📅 Book Meeting'** at the top bar to choose your preferred date, time slot, and discussion topic.

Our pricing depends on the project scope, complexity, and timeline:
• **Starter / MVP Web App**: Starts from $1,500 – $4,000 (2–4 weeks)
• **Cross-Platform Mobile App (Flutter/React Native)**: Starts from $2,500 – $6,000 (4–8 weeks)
• **Full-Scale SaaS / Enterprise Platform**: $6,000 – $15,000+
• **Dedicated Developer**: $18 – $35 / hour or flat monthly contract ($2,200 – $4,500/mo).

Would you like a customized proposal and detailed cost breakdown? Click **'📋 Request Quote'** or **'📅 Book Meeting'** above!

We specialize in end-to-end IT & Software Engineering solutions:
1. **Custom Web & SaaS Development** (React, Next.js, Node, Python)
2. **Mobile App Development** (iOS & Android via Flutter / React Native)
3. **AI & Machine Learning Integration** (Chatbots, LLMs, Automation)
4. **Cloud & DevOps Engineering** (AWS, GCP, Azure, Docker, Kubernetes)
5. **Dedicated Developer Hiring** (Staff augmentation in your time zone)
6. **UI/UX Product Design & Prototyping**

Which service are you looking for today?

Our modern technology stack includes:
• **Frontend**: React.js, Next.js, Vue.js, Tailwind CSS, TypeScript
• **Mobile**: Flutter, React Native, Swift, Kotlin
• **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python (FastAPI/Django), Go, PHP (Laravel)
• **Databases**: PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, Redis, Firebase
• **AI/ML**: Google Gemini, OpenAI, LangChain, Vector DBs
• **Cloud/DevOps**: AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD

Yes! You can hire dedicated full-time or part-time developers from us:
• **Experience**: 3 to 8+ years
• **Skills**: React, Node, Python, Flutter, DevOps, QA
• **Trial**: 1-week risk-free trial
• **Overlap**: We support US, UK, European, Middle East, and APAC time zones.

Tell us what technology and senior level you need, and we can share developer resumes within 24 hours!

Our typical delivery timelines are:
• **Landing Page / Business Website**: 5 – 10 days
• **MVP / Prototype**: 3 – 5 weeks
• **Full-featured Custom Web/Mobile App**: 2 – 3 months
• **Enterprise Solutions**: 3 – 6 months with bi-weekly sprint demos.

We strictly protect your privacy and intellectual property:
• We sign a standard **Non-Disclosure Agreement (NDA)** before discussing project specifics.
• You retain **100% full ownership** of the source code, design assets, and database upon completion.
• We adhere to OWASP standards, data encryption, and GDPR/HIPAA compliance where required.

You can connect with our solutions consulting team directly:
• 📧 **Email**: contact@novabyteinfotech.com
• 📞 **Phone**: +91 98765 43210
• 💬 **WhatsApp**: Instant response available
• 📍 **Office**: Tech Hub, 4th Floor, Silicon Valley Road

Would you like me to have our senior technical architect call you? Click **'📅 Book Meeting'** to pick a convenient slot!
